table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Status=0,
	code1 = V.AccCode, 
	date1 = V.date, 
	name2 = V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	name1 = A.name,		
	name5 = A.aliasname,		
	value1= V.Debit,
	value2= V.Credit,
	name3 = V.Remarks,
	name4 = S.name, 
	CheckNo = V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	OpenBalance=
		(SELECT isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) 
		FROM virtualgl 
		WHERE virtualgl.acccode=V.AccCode and 
			virtualgl.date < :startdate),
	V.vouchercode
FROM 
     VirtualGL V, Accounts A, SubAccounts S
WHERE
	V.AccCode IN (:acccode) and
	V.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	V.Date BETWEEN :startdate and :enddate AND
	A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	Status=1,
	code1 = V.AccCode, 
	date1 = V.date, 
	name2 = '*' + V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	name1 = A.name,		
	name5 = A.aliasname,		
	value1= V.Debit,
	value2= V.Credit,
	name3 = V.Remarks,
	name4 = S.name,
	CheckNo = V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	OpenBalance=
		(SELECT isnull(sum(debit-credit), 0) 
		FROM virtualgl 
		WHERE virtualgl.acccode=V.AccCode and 
			virtualgl.date < :startdate),
	V.vouchercode
FROM 
	(SELECT * FROM Dbo.Fn_GetUnposted_AccTrans()) AS V, 
	Accounts A, SubAccounts S
WHERE
	V.AccCode IN (:acccode) and
	V.AccCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode
ORDER BY
	name1, name5, status, date, name2, V.VRow
